items.title: Akamai’s (NASDAQ:AKAM) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue But Quarterly Revenue Guidance Slightly Misses Expectations
items.summary: Cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.4% year on year to $1.1 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.12 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.59 per share was 0.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
